# Establish an information security management system

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When the company needs an organization-wide ISMS and may seek ISO IEC 27001 certification. An owned ISMS evidence register with reviewed risks, operating controls and a recorded assurance or certification decision.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> Operational draft. Source checked on 2026-10-30. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance, certification or completed execution is claimed. The source context is international standard overview; full normative standard not reviewed. Resolve applicable law and expert review before external action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Document the intended management-system scope

agent-runnable


List organizational boundaries, services, information assets, dependencies and interested parties. Distinguish a proposed certification scope from a claim that the whole business is certified.

- Sources: [ISO/IEC 27001 public overview](https://www.iso.org/standard/27001)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve the applicable framework and risk approach

human · human approval required · hard to undo


A competent security owner reviews the current standard and applicable obligations. Assign authority and resources; this overview guide does not substitute for the full normative requirements or specialist interpretation.

- Sources: [ISO/IEC 27001 public overview](https://www.iso.org/standard/27001)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the risk and control evidence register

agent-runnable


Document identified risks, proposed treatments, control owners and supporting evidence locations. Identify gaps without claiming a written policy demonstrates an operating control.

- Sources: [ISO/IEC 27001 public overview](https://www.iso.org/standard/27001)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Implement and operate the approved controls

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Accountable control owners perform the approved activities and retain operating evidence. Training, security decisions and production changes remain human work under the relevant approval policies.

- Sources: [ISO/IEC 27001 public overview](https://www.iso.org/standard/27001)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Arrange independent review and management evaluation

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Competent reviewers assess the implemented system and management evaluates findings and corrective actions. Keep internal review, external certification and customer assurances distinct.

- Sources: [ISO/IEC 27001 public overview](https://www.iso.org/standard/27001)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Approve assurance claims and the next review

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The owner checks the evidence and any actual certificate scope before approving external claims. Record unresolved actions, review dates and who can authorize engagement with a certification body.

- Verify: An owned ISMS evidence register with reviewed risks, operating controls and a recorded assurance or certification decision.
- Sources: [ISO/IEC 27001 public overview](https://www.iso.org/standard/27001)
